groups.name: Visuals
items: All 17 Kingdom units now use six-direction layered artwork with animated body parts and separate equipment.
Outriders have articulated horses and seated riders. High Seraphs have separate wings and halos. Soldier squads retain their three-member formations.
New attack, projectile, healing, spell, aura and movement effects follow real combat events, including elite cinematic attacks.
The animation workshop previews each available character's directions and movable parts. A Kingdom test match places the complete faction on both sides.
Updated terrain and the existing Pyromancer, Bloodblade and Necromancer art pilots are included. Other faction overhauls are still in progress.

groups.name: Fixes
items: Character artwork scales consistently with board zoom. Weapon animation canvases have extra room for long equipment.
Local battles pause through the in-game menu, including pending AI turns. Online matches continue while the menu is open.
New effects respect fog visibility, pause, reduced-motion settings and match cleanup.
